text:
Ava: Quick sync on MeadowCon booth & speaking slots. Need final decisions on: 1) two QR flows (swag claim vs speaker follow-up), 2) 1-pager content for bench numbers + product bullets, 3) swag table layout and midday restock plan. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/example-meadowcon — add updates.

Jae: Re: speaking submissions 10-min lightning demo accepted (slot B). We should do a live micro-benchmark and a short slide on routing policies. Who wants the script?

Priya: I'll write the script and keep it to ~6 slides + 2 live prompts. Also I'll make a 1-click demo repo link for attendees to try later.

Marc: I'll create a compact one-pager (A5 double-sided) with 3 visuals: topology, latency chart, cost/1k tokens. Callout: "Deploy hosted or private with identical API." Need final numbers from infra.

Nora: Swag update: vendor confirmed 300 stickers, 100 beanies, 40 travel mugs. ETA Thu. Suggest we reserve 30 mugs for enterprise booth meetings (tagged). Will bring a lockable box for valuables.

Sam: For QR flows: propose a short form for swag claim (email + mailing address) and a second short form for deeper interest (company, role, use-case). Both forms tag source=meadowcon2026 and qr=swag|lead. I can make a static QR page: https://redwood.ai/meadowcon-qr that redirects with utm params.

Zoe: HubSpot: create campaign meadowcon2026, list meadowcon-qr-leads. SDRs prefer a "booked-demo" boolean if they scheduled on-site. We'll auto-assign to EMEA SDR queue for enterprise leads.

Ava: Logistics: booth layout plan attached in the sheet. We want 2 demo stations (left/right), a small seating area for 1:1s, and a swag table near the exit. Please confirm any AV needs.

Priya: AV needs: 1x HDMI, 1x backup laptop with model cache (quantized), audio for the lightning demo mic. Also need extension cord + gaffer tape.

Marc: Visuals: will export a banner with the benchmark strip (PNG and GIF). For tabletop signage: 6x QR cards (different QR for swag vs leads) + small "Try the demo" placards.

Nora: Restock plan: Nora + Ava will do a 12:30 check and top up swag. Keep sticker bowls separate for freebies, and mugs kept behind the table to avoid giveaways to bad leads. Also bring sharpies for addresses.

Jae: Speaking promo: can we promote the lightning demo in the event app and tweet the slot? Draft SM copy: "Catch our 10-min micro-benchmark demo at 11:10 — live prompts + cost beats. Booth #C12". Anyone edit?

Sam: Minor note: update the storage address to include the vendor PO # in case they ask. Vendor contact: swag-vendor@localprint.example.

Zoe: Post-event plan: 48-72h nurture sequence: 1) swag confirmation + webinar invite, 2) benchmark deep-dive + CTA to book 1:1, 3) short survey (how they plan to use inference). We'll tag flows: swag_claim, lead_interest.

Ava: Action items quick:
- Priya: final talk script + demo repo link (due in 48h)
- Marc: one-pager + social visual exports (due in 36h)
- Nora: confirm swag ETA and vendor PO # (today)
- Sam: create QR redirect page + short forms (due in 24h)
- Zoe: create HubSpot campaign + SDR routing (due in 24h)
- Jae: update event app blurb + tweet draft (due EOD)

Ava: If anyone has accessibility requests for the booth (seating/handouts), flag now. Otherwise we freeze assets tomorrow noon. Thanks y'all :rocket: 

ops-bot: Reminder created 12 hours until asset freeze.
